text:
Ryan (Sales): Scheduling Citrine Health POC perf run next Tue 9am PT. Need eng + SRE to own load plan and quick cost estimate. Customer wants 60k reqs/hour, 10 concurrent clients, 8k token avg responses. Any blockers?
Jen (Eng): I can lead. Quick clarifying Qs: is 10 concurrent clients at steady state or spikes? what model variant (gpt-large-v1 / quantized) and max seq?
Ryan (Sales): They want hosted API initially, can fall back to Dedicated if latencies are worse than 200ms P95. Spikes: 5min bursts up to 100 concurrent. Model: customer asked for "redwood-3b" (we'll map to rwd-3B-8k).
Marco (Solutions): For hosted, we need to size batching & rate limits. I'd recommend starting with 8 workers, batch size 32, token limit 8k. I'll draft a runbook.
Olivia (SRE): Network egress and VPC peering likely fine. Need customer's IP ranges for allowlist and security questionnaire signed. Also any data retention constraints?
Ryan (Sales): They will sign standard DPA, retention 30 days for logs. IP ranges to follow later.
Jen (Eng): Plan: smoke test -> ramp to 10 concurrent steady -> 5min spike to 100 -> ramp down. Metrics to gather: P50/P95/P99 latency, token/sec, GPU util, queue depth. I'll attach a curl sample for load generator.
Jen (Eng): ```bash
# sample pgbench-like request
for i in {1..1000}; do curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-3B-8k\",\"input\":\"<sample prompt>\",\"max_new_tokens\":256}' & done
```
Marco (Solutions): For cost estimate: hosted at target throughput ~ 60k rph with avg 512 tokens generated per request = ~30M tokens => approx $X/day. Need to pull current per-token pricing; I'll ping finance. :moneybag: 
infra-bot: Load test cluster created: cluster-id ct-211234. Start time reserved Tue 09:00 PT.
Olivia (SRE): I'll run network oom and tail-latency checks. Can someone confirm we have a sample prompt set (20 prompts) that represents real traffic?
Ryan (Sales): I'll get prompt set from customer and drop in the shared bucket by EOD Friday.
Jen (Eng): One more: we should enable KV cache warmup, otherwise first-run latencies will be inflated. Set warmup=true in runbook.
Marco (Solutions): Noted. Also recommend a fallback policy to smaller model variant rwd-1.3b if P95 > 350ms.
Jen (Eng): Agreed. After run I'll post a short results snapshot: expected columns TS,P50,P95,P99,tokens/sec,gpu_util,errors.
Ryan (Sales): Thanks all — goal is to get a result and an exec summary for the customer by Wed following test. :thumbsup:
